dominant_uncertainty: missing zero-point energy: DELTA_ZPE = ZPE_ads(per H) - ZPE(H2)/2 ~ +0.20 eV shifts the delta_mu axis rigidly, moving the crossing temperature by of order 100-200 K (pressure dependent) TOWARDS lower temperature, i.e. MORE accessible. The ideal-gas fit residual (temperature_fit_residual_k) is ~30x smaller and is not the limiting term. ZPE is quoted, not applied, because applying the H2 side alone would be unbalanced; analyze_h_phonons.py computes the adsorbed side properly.
what_is_computed: DFT (this project): E(H2), slab total energies, hence gamma(H-rich) and its slope N_H/2A; tau per facet; the continuum interior stress and its sign
what_is_ideal_gas: ideal-gas statistical thermodynamics with literature H2 spectroscopic constants: the entire T and p dependence (rigid rotor with explicit level sum, harmonic oscillator, no ZPE, no anharmonicity)
